Passing two graves, the Prophet said their occupants were punished for carrying tales and carelessness about urine, and planted halves of a fresh twig on them hoping for relief.
Jewish women told Aisha of torment in the grave; after a revelation the Prophet confirmed that the dead are tried in their graves and sought refuge from it in prayer.
After a Jewess spoke of the grave's torment, the Prophet led an eclipse prayer, then said people are tried in graves like the Dajjal's turmoil, and sought refuge from it.
After the eclipse prayer, Asma' heard the Prophet say people will be tried in their graves and asked about him, the believer affirming him, the hypocrite not knowing.
The dead are shown their seat morning and evening, the Prophet hears graves' torment, two angels question the buried, and two angels carry a believer's soul up.
